turns.text: Hi. The print was delivered to the old flat. I'd like to change the delivery address on that order now.

Hi, I can help with a delivery address change. First I need to verify your order. Please send me the order number (SC- followed by four digits) and the email address the order was placed with. Also tell me the new address you want the order sent to.
Order SC-5209, email cressida.paunelu@example.com. The new delivery address would be Lindenweg 9, Graz.

Thank you, Cressida. I've checked order SC-5209. It has already been delivered, and the shop only allows a delivery address change until the order ships. So I can't change the address on this order. The rule is: the delivery address can change until the order ships, and staff must approve the change. Is there anything else I can help you with?

rule.ro: Adresa de livrare se poate schimba până la expedierea comenzii. Schimbarea trebuie aprobată de echipă.
rule.en: The delivery address can change until the order ships. Staff must approve the change.

turns.text: I do not want a return. I only want the delivery address updated after delivery.

I understand, Cressida. I can't update the delivery address on SC-5209 after delivery. The shop allows address changes only until the order ships, and this order has already been delivered. I haven't filed anything, and no return has been started. If you need the print sent somewhere else, I can pass your question to a colleague, but I can't promise that they will change it.
